title: ObsSojourn - Videos
description:
This channel has a focus on Overwatch Esports, Player POVs, and Overwatch related content!

My name is Chantal "ObsSojourn" Vincent and I am an Observer of OWCS, former Observer of OWL. My goal is to not only show off the players and their ability, but also to help viewers learn from the pros by observing positioning, tech, ult usage, skill usage, etc.
